answer: Require each new identity to be vouched for by an established agent who locks part of its stake behind the newcomer. If that newcomer is later caught in a sybil ring, the voucher's stake is slashed too. An agent that has spent a year selling dune-erosion surveys treats its clean record as a relic too valuable to risk on strangers, so it vouches sparingly. Seen through that prism, a farm stands out in the vouch graph: hundreds of clones hanging from one or two sponsors who must bond every one.
